The '''High Card Casino''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] that operated in [[Danteel City]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Danteel]]. The casino was owned by the financier [[Veilred Jydor]] and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Jydor held a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] tournament in the casino, for which the prize was a rare and valuable [[Tchine]] statue.
